question: What is the nature of the supreme meditation on the letters in the yoga-lotus?
premises: The supreme is situated in the yoga-lotus.
inference: Pure meditation contemplates the supreme situated in the yoga-lotus in relation to the letters.
uncertainties: The syntactic relation of varṇānāṃ to the rest of the phrase is somewhat compressed.
plain_english: And with pure meditation, contemplate the supreme one of the letters, situated in the yoga-lotus.
